steps.name: Set up job
Run actions/checkout@v5

Run sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y libasound2-dev libcurl4-openssl-dev libfreetype6-dev libfontconfig1-dev libx11-dev libxcomposite-dev libxcursor-dev libxext-dev libxinerama-dev libxrandr-dev libxrender-dev libgl1-mesa-dev xvfb openbox x11-utils
Verify immutable released fixture provenance
Run cmake -S . -B build-legacy -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCHIMERA_EQ_DEVELOPMENT_PREVIEW=ON
Run cmake --build build-legacy --config Release --target ChimeraEQLegacyStateTests ChimeraEQNormalizationTests ChimeraGraphicalEQEditingTests ChimeraEQSnapshotFreezeTests --parallel 2
Existing synthetic contracts and real binary fixture contracts
Run cmake --build build-legacy --config Release --target ChimeraVST3EQStateHost ChimeraAmpMatrix_VST3 --parallel 2
Download and capture the unchanged public beta.2 binary
Replay old numeric VST3 automation IDs and reopen with the old binary
Exact canonical-state renders through released and candidate VST3
Run actions/upload-artifact@v6
Post Run actions/checkout@v5
Complete job
